method: Two ordinary dated photographs and retained standard map plan. No bespoke survey research.

pictures.observed: Two tapered shafts and transverse cap, haunched concrete girders, open damaged deck ends and surviving blue/yellow lamps.

pictures.author: Vl.Gizycki
pictures.observed: Broad road/footways, broken multi-span gap with slumped deck pieces, exposed reinforcement, partly standing supports and blue/yellow bent lamp standards. Temporary barges visible alongside are excluded.

reconstructionLimits: Mapped slab remnants fix the major gap locations; inferred support schedule, debris shapes and provisional vertical levels are original visual reconstruction. Damage state is dated and not independently verified as a new2026 survey.
redistribution: Photographs inspected in browser only; no pixels or third-party meshes redistributed.
